title: On Depressing everybody in the house
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：depress　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 depress 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the craftsman ① depressed everybody in the house in the rain, and every apprentice in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the craftsman ② depresses everybody in the house without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ depress everybody in the house at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ depressed everybody in the house before — a line in the ledger for August 1950 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Depressing everybody in the house in the rain, the craftsman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ depress the price of corn for years without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Depress the price of corn for years at once and never mention it again.

By 1963 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new apprentice from the next workshop ⑧ depresses the price of corn for years in the rain every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ depressed everybody in the house again when nobody else would.

⑩ To depress everybody in the house, my mother said in 1968, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody depresses everybody in the house without complaint again and somebody must depress everybody in the house in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 使沮丧（一般过去式 depressed everybody in the house：1956 年匠人头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 使沮丧（一般现在 depresses everybody in the house：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 使沮丧（不定式 to depress everybody in the house：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 使沮丧（过去完成时 had depressed everybody in the house：1950 年八月的工料簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 使沮丧（动名词 depressing everybody in the house 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 压低（depress the price of corn for years：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去压低把粮价压低了几年）
G. v. 压低（depress the price of corn for years：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 使沮丧（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 depresses the price of corn for years，而母亲又一次 depressed everybody in the house）

answers.why: depress 意为“使沮丧”，1956 年匠人淋着雨使沮丧让屋里所有人垂头丧气，那是工坊里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 depressed。
depress 意为“使沮丧”，自那以后匠人毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 depresses。
depress 意为“使沮丧”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯使沮丧让屋里所有人垂头丧气”，此处为不定式 to depress everybody in the house。
depress 意为“使沮丧”，工料簿里 八月 那行字说明早在 1963 年之前就有人使沮丧过，故用过去完成时 had depressed。
depress 意为“使沮丧”，匠人说“使沮丧让屋里所有人垂头丧气这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 depressing everybody in the house 作主语。
depress 意为“压低”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去压低把粮价压低了几年”，should ever 之后用原形 depress the price of corn for years。
depress 意为“压低”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻压低把粮价压低了几年（depress the price of corn for years at once），以后再也不要提起。
depress 意为“使沮丧”，新来的学徒每个年头都照例压低把粮价压低了几年，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 depresses。
depress 意为“使沮丧”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨使沮丧让屋里所有人垂头丧气，用一般过去式 depressed 叙述。
depress 意为“使沮丧”，结尾那句是母亲 1968 年的话：要使沮丧让屋里所有人垂头丧气，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工坊记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 depress 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the craftsman depressed everybody in the house in the rain, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the craftsman depresses everybody in the house without complaint whenever the workshop asks.
Depressing everybody in the house in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever depress the price of corn for years without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next workshop depresses the price of corn for years in the rain every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother depressed everybody in the house again, and the workshop remembered that half.
